## Does searching use up my credits?

Running a search does not spend credits. Credits are spent when a lead is added to
your list, one credit per new lead. Leads you have already paid for in an earlier
search are not charged again.

## What happens when credits run out

The chat stops generating new leads and asks you to top up. Existing lists, campaigns
and mailboxes are unaffected.
